canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Commodity Supplemental Food Program (CSFP)
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: USDA FNA describes CSFP as monthly USDA Foods support for qualifying low-income people age 60 and older. State/ITO rules and local service-area availability vary; published statements below are not executable criteria.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: Participants must be at least 60 years of age.

State agencies and Indian Tribal Organizations set household income limits at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines; an agency may set a lower limit. The 2026 annual table is published separately by geography and household size.
A state agency or Indian Tribal Organization may set local residency requirements based on designated service areas, but may not require a minimum period of residency.
A state agency or Indian Tribal Organization may require participants to be at nutritional risk, as determined by a physician or local agency staff.
CSFP may not be available in every area within a participating state; applicants must verify local availability with the state distributing agency or local agency.

canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.title: Senior Farmers Market Nutrition Program (SFMNP)
canonical_attributes.eligibility.program.description: USDA FNA describes SFMNP as support for low-income seniors through state-administered farmers market programs. The federal page gives a general age/income description and points to current 2026-2027 guidelines; state participation and actual rules must be checked.

eligibility.program.published_requiremen.statement: USDA FNA generally defines low-income seniors served by SFMNP as individuals at least 60 years old. State program rules should be checked.

USDA FNA generally describes SFMNP as serving seniors with household income not more than 185% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines. This general description does not replace the current participating state agency rules.
SFMNP operates through state, territory, and tribal administering agencies; availability must be verified for the applicant jurisdiction and local program.

USDA FNA lists 2026-2027 SFMNP Income Eligibility Guidelines, published 2026-04-10. The linked guideline body/table was not available for direct extraction in this review; no household-size dollar amounts are asserted in this record.
